title: Automated Oxygen Titration With the EMILY.AI Device During the Six-Minute Walk Test
official: Functional, Clinical, and Predictive Validation Study of the EMILY AI Device in Patients With Acute and Chronic Respiratory Failure: Exercise Substudy (Six-Minute Walk Test) in Ambulatory Patients
summary:
This study evaluates EMILY.AI, an investigational (non-CE-marked) smart oxygen valve that automatically adjusts the oxygen flow delivered to a patient.

Adults with chronic respiratory disease who need oxygen during exertion perform two six-minute walk tests on the same day, 30 minutes apart: one with oxygen adjusted automatically by EMILY.AI and one with a fixed oxygen flow delivered through the same device. The order is randomized and participants do not know which test uses automatic titration.

The study compares the time spent within the target saturation range, desaturation, oxygen use, walking distance, breathlessness and participant preference between the two tests. This substudy is part of clinical investigation FJD-EMILY-23-02, whose other substudies are registered in separate records.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 40 to 90 years with a chronic respiratory disease.
* Indication for exertional oxygen therapy, defined as SpO2 below 88% during a six-minute walk test and/or resting respiratory failure (PaO2 below 60 mmHg).
* Able to understand the study and sign informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Decompensated acute or chronic disease with severe organ involvement, such as cardiovascular disease.
* Musculoskeletal or neurological disease preventing stable and safe walking.
* Comorbidities or treatments that, by intensity or dose, limit performance of the tests or interpretation of the results (such as alcohol use, beta-blockers, or other neurological or psychiatric drugs).
* Walking limitation preventing the six-minute walk test, or cardiovascular or connective tissue disease limiting accurate transcutaneous pulse oximetry.
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding (women of childbearing potential require a negative pregnancy test at screening).
